$comment: Written by the sweep in apps/mobile/test/screens.test.tsx (F-204). A verdict without a count is not evidence: "no findings" and "nothing ran" produce the same word, so the subject and condition counts are part of the record. Regenerated by `pnpm test`.

claims.$comment: F-221 (ADR-0134 D3): every tree rendered in every condition, read as paragraphs, visual lines (paragraphs side by side in a row) and accessible names, against the claims lint patterns. pnpm fidelity:capture reads a device capture the same way.

inventory.$comment: F-221 (ADR-0134 D1, D7): the surfaces enrolled, each rendered in both themes and both languages with every inventory element found by what it draws; the rest owed to the feature that builds each, or not a whole surface, with why.

notWhole.00.board: The vocabulary board: it governs words, parts and type (P3), and draws no screen a route renders.
notWhole.14.icon: The launcher icon: an asset, held by generate-brand-assets --check and gate 16, not a screen.
notWhole.25.screen: The light palette over 01 (P2): its layout is 01's, built and enrolled by F-242.
notWhole.26.screen: Japanese over 06 (P2): its layout is 06's, built and enrolled by F-247.

cited.cvd: NOT re-simulated here. Gate 9 (pnpm test:contrast) runs every declared pairing through WCAG, APCA and eleven CVD severities across every declared palette. A second simulation would be a second answer to one question (E-005).
cited.tokenReach: NOT checked here. scripts/verify-token-reach.mjs (F-092) checks both directions — a token no component reads, and an exemption a component does read — and prints the whole exemption list on every run. 86 names: 67 read, 19 declared unreached with a reason.

notCovered: That any of it LOOKS right. This sweep renders trees and measures structure, naming, tap targets, token resolution and selection treatment. It cannot see a layout that is cramped or unbalanced — and every "unprofessional" report in this project has been about something that was green here at the time. That is what pnpm fidelity:capture is for (F-221, ADR-0134): every route from the running app beside its mockup, compared by a person.
